name: Set AC
description: Replaces the wearer's own AC calculation with a fixed formula, rather than adding to it.

mechanics.text: While active, the wearer's own AC becomes featureParams.base (plus their own featureParams.modifier ability modifier, if set) instead of being calculated normally — REPLACES the AC calculation outright, unlike feat.protection-bonus (an additive bonus on top of whatever AC the wearer already has) or feat.ac-minimum (a floor, letting other bonuses still exceed it).
